name: qlrisk_credit_risk
title: Credit risk measures
description: Credit-risk calculators: pd (probability of default: structural Merton, reduced form, rating transition matrix, logistic, historical), lgd (fixed, collateral, workout, market, stochastic), ead, el (expected loss = PD x LGD x EAD), economic_capital (Vasicek, Gordy, Monte Carlo; also EL, VaR and ES of the loss distribution) and raroc (risk-adjusted return on capital vs a hurdle). Units: probabilities, LGDs, recoveries, rates, haircuts and volatilities in percent (pd_pct 2 = 2%), spreads in basis points (credit_spread_bp 120 = 1.2%), maturities and horizons in years, margin periods in business days; amounts in the trade currency. Fields per measure: pd: asset_value, debt_value, asset_volatility_pct (%), risk_free_rate_pct (%), time_horizon_years (years, default 1), hazard_rate_pct (%), credit_rating, rating_pd_pct (%), financial_ratios, model_coefficients. lgd: exposure (default 0.0), recovery_pct (%), collateral, recovery_history_pct (%), bond_price (per 100), lgd_mean_pct (%), lgd_std_pct (%), is_senior (default true), is_secured (default false). ead: current_exposure*, notional*, credit_conversion_factor_pct (%, default 100), add_on_factor_pct (%, default 0), collateral_value (default 0.0), collateral_haircut_pct (%, default 0), netting_benefit_pct (%, default 0), margin_period_of_risk_days (business days, default 10), replacement_cost, pfe_add_on. el: pd_pct* (%), lgd_pct (%), ead (default 0.0), time_horizon_years (years, default 1), maturity_years (years), recovery_pct (%), pd_term_structure_pct (%), time_points (years). economic_capital: exposures*, pds_pct* (%), lgds_pct* (%), asset_correlation (0 to 1, default 0.2), correlation_matrix, ead (single obligor), pd_pct (%), lgd_pct (%), confidence_pct (%, default 99.9), time_horizon_years (years, default 1). raroc: revenue*, fee_income (default 0.0), spread_income (default 0.0), trading_income (default 0.0), operating_cost (default 0.0), funding_cost (default 0.0), hedging_cost (default 0.0), expected_loss (default 0.0), economic_capital (default 0.0), regulatory_capital (default 0.0), cva (default 0.0), fva (default 0.0), kva (default 0.0), tax_rate_pct (%, default 25), hurdle_rate_pct (%). Config: pd: model (structural|reduced_form|transition_matrix|logistic|historical), time_horizon_years; lgd: model (fixed|collateral|workout|market|stochastic), default_lgd_pct, floor_pct, cap_pct; ead: method (cem|imm|sa_ccr), alpha, include_margin; el: time_horizon_years, annualize, use_term_structure; economic_capital: method (gordy|monte_carlo|vasicek), confidence_pct, num_simulations; raroc: hurdle_rate_pct, include_xva, use_regulatory_capital. Inputs: measure, inputs, config. Example: {"measure": "el", "inputs": {"pd_pct": 2, "lgd_pct": 45, "ead": 1000000}} gives EL: 9,000.00.
